description:
### Gboard Clipboard History (v1.0.0)

* **Native Gboard integration**: Clipboard History manager opens straight from Keyboard Settings (no separate launcher icon)
* **Package coexistence**: Optional rename to com.sj010.gboard so it installs side by side with stock Gboard
* **Read-only ContentProvider**: Companion apps can read the history through content://com.sj010.gboardclipboard.history/clips

Supports Gboard v18.4.1 (Release), v18.3.1 (Release / Beta) and v18.0.3 (Release).
